items.briefing:
Australian employees should be aware that AI tools are quietly adding to workplace workload rather than reducing it, according to new research flagged locally — staff may be spending unplanned time managing or correcting AI outputs without realising the hidden cost. Separately, researchers have demonstrated that AI agents can generate self-replicating malware with minimal human involvement, a reminder that AI misuse risks are evolving quickly and organisations should have clear policies around AI tool usage.

A newly identified Linux botnet (Evooo1Bot) is also expanding its attack capabilities beyond simple disruption, potentially targeting networked devices. **Practical tip:** Review what AI tools your team is using day-to-day and ensure they are approved by your organisation before staff rely on them for work tasks.

featured.title: Proofpoint warns of myGov & invoice scams in Australia
featured.quote: Australians lost $2.18 billion to scams in 2025 using fake myGov and invoice tactics.
